page.overview:
Who is Henry?

Henry is a man who worked for Dr. Jack Thorne.

When Arby Benton and Kelly Curtis went to Thorne Mobile Field Systems to visit Doc Thorne, Thorne asked Henry to read the blueprint carefully that the pole of high observation platform should be put slanted instead of horizontally so it could support more weight.
